articles.author: Stelixx Insider
articles.description:
Building products that charge based on usage presents unique challenges, especially when it comes to metering and billing. Whether you're dealing with AI API calls, cloud compute minutes, or specific events within your SaaS platform, ensuring accuracy, reliability, and scalability is paramount. 
OpenMeter is an open-source project designed to tackle these very issues. It provides a robust and flexible framework for tracking usage metrics, enabling you to implement sophisticated pricing strategies without the heavy lifting of building such a system from scratch. Its design emphasizes seamless integration with your existing tech stack, making it an excellent choice for developers looking to create fair and transparent billing experiences for their users.
Key benefits include:
Reliable event ingestion and metering
Scalable architecture to handle high volumes
Clean integration points for billing systems
Open-source transparency and community support
If you're in the process of developing or refining a usage-based business model, OpenMeter is definitely worth exploring.


  
  
  Stelixx #StelixxInsights #IdeaToImpact #AI #Web3 #FinTech #BuilderCommunity #OpenSource
articles.title: OpenMeter: Giải pháp Open-Source cho Metering và Billing

macOS solved this by hiding POSIX, not exposing it.
Backward Compatibility Matters More on Desktops

Servers Want Homogeneity; Desktops Are Chaotic
Servers are:

Why POSIX Eventually Entered Desktops (But Didn’t Take Over)
POSIX did reach desktops  quietly.

It’s there for:
Not for:

Why POSIX Won Servers Completely
Servers care about:
